description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductOptionValueDao' which extends a generic DAO interface, providing methods for accessing 'ProductOptionValue' entities in the context of specific 'MerchantStore' and 'Language' objects. These methods include listing, retrieving by ID, name, and code, tailored for catalog product attribute options within the sales manager system.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDao
classes.description: A Java interface that extends a generic DAO to manage 'ProductOptionValue' entities with methods for querying by store, name, ID, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of 'ProductOptionValue' objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ProductOptionValue' by store and ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'ProductOptionValue' objects matching a given name in a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of 'ProductOptionValue' objects for a store and language, possibly excluding read-only entries.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ProductOptionValue' by its code within a store.
